title: What kind of website do you need?
subtitle: A landing page for one offer, a company website for your services or an online store for your products. I also update existing websites.
estimateTitle: Need an estimate for your case?
estimateDescription: Tell me what you sell, who your client is and what the website should achieve. I will help define the right format, scope and a realistic launch plan.

labels.estimatePitch: Clear scope, realistic timing and a launch plan that makes commercial sense.

services.title: Landing page
services.description: One page for a product, service or advertising campaign, with a clear offer, answers to common questions and an enquiry form.

services.title: Company website
services.description: A multi-page company website with services, business information, case studies and contact details.

services.title: Online store
services.description: An online store with a product catalogue, cart, checkout, payments and delivery.

services.title: Website redesign
services.description: Design updates, performance improvements and migration of an existing website, preserving important pages and redirecting changed URLs.

advantages.title: Outcome over feature list
advantages.description: Each service is packaged around what should change for the business after launch, not just what gets built.

advantages.title: Clear process
advantages.description: Scope, structure, technical stack and delivery priorities are defined early, so the project stays controlled.

advantages.title: Built for growth
advantages.description: Performance, SEO, analytics and future expansion are part of the initial system instead of patched in later.
